text:
emma_finance: Quick flag  VectorCloud sent a pricing appendix for embeddings. There's ambiguity on how they bill for deduped/cache hits vs fresh vectors. Can ops/ML sanity-check before procurement responds?

noah_procure: Share the snippet you received.

emma_finance: From the appendix:

```
Embedding SKU: $0.001 per vector-hour OR $0.00002 per vector-request (dependent on mode).
Cache deduction: billed only on "emitted vectors".
Overage: billed at 150% of committed rate.
Onboarding: $10k one-time.
```

ravi_ml: The dual-mode pricing is odd. We use heavy batching; if they charge per-request we win, per-vector-hour could be enormous depending on their definition. Need clarification: is vector-hour = active vector in memory * hours, or aggregated emitted vectors over time?

zoe_ops: Also ask if cached vectors that are served from KV count as emitted. If yes, cost explodes for any re-used embeddings. We must have a caching exemption or at least KV-hit discount.

vendor_rep: Hi all  I can clarify: vector-hour is billed as "sum of unique vector instances served to the model per hour". Cache hits to our managed KV are not billed unless the vector is re-computed. Burst overage applies only after 120% of commit. Happy to provide sample invoices.

emma_finance: Good start but need this in writing and examples. Ask them for: 1) sample invoice with mapping to our reported telemetry, 2) API for real-time usage export, 3) contract clause: price lock for 12 months and max overage rate 125%, 4) audit right quarterly.

noah_procure: Also request onboarding fee convertable to usage credits if commit reached within 90 days and pilot PO capped at $25k with overage opt-out.

ravi_ml: Technical ask: provide the protobuf or JSON schema for the usage API and define what constitutes a "unique vector" (hashing rules, dimension quantization). Also confirm whether near-duplicate vectors are deduped.

vendor_rep: We'll supply sample invoices, usage API spec, and a technical note on deduping. Can you send a consolidated ask list by EOD?

emma_finance: Sending consolidated asks shortly. procurement_bot: tag vendor-contract and set milestone 2024-08-01.

procurement_bot: Tagged vendor-contract. Reminder: attach appendix and sample invoices to Confluence.
